description:
Clear a native operand-readout frame only at the marked equals position.

Five literal GLUs share the marker gate: one raw RMS anchor and four linear
frame cancellations. Native feature repair is one closed-form solve on
unlabeled calibration text only. Recorded prefix activations are used solely
to check that native source-token behavior is preserved by that repair.

extra.native_source_prefix_check: Recorded native branch outputs on individual source prefixes, no digit/sum target

geometry_report.target: Individual current token and head only; centered digit and constant, with zero-sum free head offsets
geometry_report.selection: Minimum maximum individual-source-code residual across construction and independent validation tokens
